baseline_models.mechanism: The active drinkers plus the cognate verbal noun intensify liquid intake, while severe thirst without satiety removes the act's natural stopping point.

activation_trace.role: Liquid intake supplies the concrete act and its doubled wording presents sustained performance.
Severe thirst that does not reach quenching makes the drinking internally non-terminating.

changed_reading.after: They remain drinkers in an act prolonged by a thirst that drinking cannot end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شُرْبَ is governed by drinkers, while ٱلْهِيمِ can image water-swallowing dry sand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Absorption joins drinking to the image of fine dry sand that takes water without retaining a stable, refreshing pool; each draught disappears into the receiver.

activation_trace.role: Absorption and mixing into a material recast drinking as liquid disappearing into its recipient.
Dry fine sand that swallows water supplies the porous material analogy.

changed_reading.after: The bodies behave like absorbent ground: every draught vanishes into them without becoming relief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated drinking is qualified by the diseased and wandering ranges of ه ي م.
baseline_models.mechanism: A thirst disease that drives camels to wander until destruction turns reiterated drinking from purposeful refreshment into a self-propelling pathology.

activation_trace.role: Repeated liquid intake is the observable action around which the pathological circuit turns.
Camel thirst disease combines inability to be quenched, wandering, and terminal bodily disorder.
Aimless motion without a governing destination makes the action compulsive rather than restorative.

changed_reading.before: The drinking answers an extreme need.
changed_reading.after: The drinking is itself one turn in a disordered circuit whose drive no longer reaches a restorative goal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Penetrating heat surrounds them, the available liquid is hot, and cooling stillness is negated; drinking therefore carries the injuring environment inward and renews the thirst that prompted it.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating hot wind supplies heat that invades rather than merely surrounds.
Hot water supplies the liquid taken immediately before the focus intensifies the drinking.
The negated image of cooling as stillness after heat marks the unavailable terminus.
Liquid intake is the transfer mechanism that brings the hot medium into the body.
Unquenched thirst closes the feedback loop by demanding further intake.

structural_cues: 56:42-44 establishes heat and explicitly denies cooling; 56:54 places the hot drink directly before the focus repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies penetrating heat, hot water, denied cooling, and unquenched thirst; I supply the arrow that ingestion internalizes and renews the heat. A live alternative is simple accumulation of torments without a feedback loop.

changed_reading.before: The quantity of drinking fails to satisfy thirst.
changed_reading.after: Every attempted relief imports more of the injury, so the drink helps regenerate the need to drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eating becomes swallowing, the interior is filled to the measure of its container, and liquid is then taken on top of that fullness; the focus is an impossible further addition rather than an answer to emptiness.

activation_trace.role: Taking food initiates the ordered bodily intake.
Swallowing and gulping make passage into the interior mechanically explicit.
Filling until contents equal the vessel establishes bodily capacity as already reached.
The belly as an interior identifies the filled container.
Liquid intake follows and is explicitly placed upon the prior contents.
Thirst without satiety forces addition even after the bodily vessel is full.

structural_cues: The consecutive فـ clauses in 56:53-55 accelerate filling, drinking upon it, and intensified drinking.
The pronoun in عَلَيْهِ at 56:54 binds the drink to the already completed eating and filling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies swallowing, a full belly, drinking upon its contents, and unsated thirst; I infer pressure against an already full interior. A live alternative is chronological excess without a pressure or overflow model.

changed_reading.after: They must keep adding liquid to an interior already at capacity, turning consumption into bodily overfilling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prior abundance released appetite, repeated persistence bound conduct into a knot, and the focus realizes that bound appetite as pathological thirst; formerly discretionary consumption returns as compulsion.

activation_trace.role: Abundant ease that releases its possessor supplies the earlier condition of unrestrained appetite.
Binding and knotting give persistence a mechanism of habit hardened into constraint.
The root's thirst image makes the movement from moral persistence to bodily craving visible.
Sustained intake is the bodily behavior in which the earlier pattern reappears.
Thirst disease converts appetite into a drive that continues toward bodily destruction.

structural_cues: 56:45-46 gives a retrospective causal frame with repeated كَانُوا۟ before 56:52-55 enacts repeated consumption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior released ease, persistent binding, thirst, and intake; I infer an inversion in which chosen excess becomes imposed appetite. A live alternative is moral chronology with no continuity between the former habit and present drinking.

changed_reading.before: The drinking is an isolated imposed penalty.
changed_reading.after: The drinking embodies an old appetite returned in inverted form: what was once indulged freely now commands them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A named company is gathered into one body, receives a water-share as a drinking company, and has the whole sequence labeled prepared provision under recompense; the drink becomes a corporate allotment.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and lasting association constitute the drinkers as a named cohort.
Gathering dispersed people into one whole supplies the corporate assembly.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest frames the preceding intake as an inverted reception.
Accounting and recompense assign the provision its distributive logic.
A defined water-share makes the drink legible as an allotted portion.
The drinking company joins the plural grammar to the assembled cohort.

structural_cues: Plural labels and participles run from أَصْحَٰبُ in 56:41 through the consumers in 56:52-55.
The deictic هَٰذَا in 56:56 packages the preceding sequence as their provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohort, gathering, water-share, prepared provision, and recompense; I infer that the liquid functions as an allotted corporate ration. A live alternative is that نُزُل labels the punishment generally without distribution semantics.

changed_reading.before: Many individuals happen to perform the same desperate act.
changed_reading.after: A gathered company receives and consumes its assigned share in an inverted hospitality of recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oral apparatus first voices denial, then becomes jaw-space, swallowing passage, and throat channel; the mouth is reversed from an instrument that projects claims into a conduit compelled to receive.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as speech instrument establishes the mouth's earlier outward agency.
Contradiction of truth identifies the speech act whose bodily reversal follows.
The branch image of the space between the jaws localizes the punitive sequence in the mouth.
Gulping and swallowing turn the mouth from output toward forced inward passage.
Mouth and throat channels provide the final conduit through which the liquid passes.

structural_cues: The quoted challenge in 56:47-48 is followed by direct identification as deniers in 56:51 and uninterrupted oral intake in 56:52-55.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, denial, jaw-space, swallowing, and throat channels; I supply the organ-level reversal from outward assertion to inward reception. A live alternative is narrative succession without a designed mouth mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports the final act in a sequence of eating and drinking.
changed_reading.after: The drinking is an embodied counter-utterance: the mouth that issued denial is made a passive channel for what it denied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ق ب ل is temporal in 56:45 and the neck-rope image is a distant ش ر ب branch. It remains anchored by focus drinking, the camel thirst-disease range of ه ي م, and convergent watering, rope, and knot images; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory loss-of-agency analogy, never as the lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus ش ر ب supplies both drinking and a neck-restraint branch, while ه ي م supplies diseased thirsty camels.

activation_trace.role: Watering at camels' mouths supplies the managed-at-the-mouth scene despite the source occurrence's temporal use.
Binding and knotting makes restraint, rather than free approach to water, mechanically coherent.
A rope placed around the neck supplies the tether linking drinking to constrained bodily posture.
Diseased thirsty camels provide the focus-anchored herd body and its inability to reach satiety.

changed_reading.before: They drink with the intensity of pathologically thirsty camels.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble a diseased herd tethered and driven to water at the mouth, making loss of agency part of the drinking image.

strongest_changes: The hot drink is not failed relief only; it internalizes the surrounding heat and helps renew thirst.
The sequence fills the belly before adding liquid, turning drinking into impossible addition to an already full bodily vessel.
Group, share, provision, and recompense cues recast the plural drinking as a corporate allotment in inverted hospitality.
summary.what_was_special: The focus repetition supported three simultaneous scales: an unending physiological loop, a material absorption model, and a social ration. Context then exposed reversals of remedy into injury, appetite into compulsion, hospitality into recompense, and speech into forced intake.
remaining_uncertainties: The heat feedback arrow may be stronger than a simpler reading in which distinct torments merely accumulate.
The allotted-share model depends on connecting the focus water-share branch to the later provision label.
The tethered-watering outlier is deliberately branch-distant and should remain an analogy rather than enter an unqualified synthesis.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Repeated drinking driven by thirst that cannot terminate itself.** The verb-cognate noun activates `ش ر ب` **B001** as an intensified process; `ه ي م` **B001** supplies raging thirst and **B003** camel thirst-sickness. **Abductive move:** I infer a feedback loop in which drinking fails to quench and therefore causes more drinking. **Reading change:** the line depicts compulsive consumption rather than a single draught.

2. **Water swallowed like by thirsty sand.** `ه ي م` **B002** supplies sand that swallows water. The earlier earth-to-dust sequence and the later cultivation sequence supply a material contrast: water here disappears without fertility. **Abductive move:** I infer that the drinkers function like an absorbent waste that yields nothing. **Reading change:** unquenchable bodies become barren terrain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ordinary water at 56:68 and its possible salting at 56:70 exposed this thirst-loop as a failure of usable provision, not merely excess appetite.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The cognate drinking construction specifies a self-perpetuating thirst pattern.** Repeated verb and maṣdar activate `ش ر ب` (B001, drinking liquid), while `ه ي م` (B001, severe thirst that is not quenched; B003, thirst-sickness marked by failure to be satisfied) supplies the manner. Ayat 50–54 narrow gathering into hot intake; ayat 56–60 name it as provision and immediately recall the hearers’ first creation. The packet supplies intensive drinking modeled on unsatisfied thirst; I infer a loop in which quantity cannot achieve the act’s normal endpoint. The line changes repeated drinking from abundance into incapacity for satiation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:70 makes gratitude the response to drinkable water, revealing this unsatisfied drinking as the negative image of a provision relation whose giver and suitability are unrecognized.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Şiddetli susuzluk burada temeldir; suya kanmama ve buna bağlı yönsüz dolaşma deve hastalığı dalında kalır.

facets.statement: Bedensel ihtiyacın ileri derecesini bildiren şiddetli susuzluk.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi şiddetli susuzluk ile çok susamış kişi arasındadır; kullanım ayrıca susamış develere ve insan topluluklarına uzanır. Suya kanmama ise burada zorunlu bir özellik değildir.

branches.branch_image_ar: داء عطش يصيب الإبل فتتيه ولا تروى
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهيام داء الإبل من العطش أو من ماء مستنقع، وحال البعير أو الناقة التي لا تروى وتهيم أو تدور حتى تهلك.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق العطش بلا داء، ولا تيه العاشق أو الشاعر إلا من جهة التشبيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهيام داء يأخذ الإبل عند عطشها فتهيم في الأرض لا ترعوي (maqayis)؛ داء يأخذ الإبل فتهيم في الأرض لا ترعى (sihah)؛ داء فلا تروى من الماء (tahdhib)؛ داء يصيب الإبل من ماء تشربه مستنقعا (tahdhib)؛ داء شبيه بالحمى؛ نحو الدوار جنون يأخذ البعير حتى يهلك (tahdhib)؛ داء يأخذ الإبل من العطش (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi amaç gözetmeden gitme ve şaşkın dolaşma çekirdeğini doğrular, ancak bunu yalnız aşka veya şaşkınlığa bağlamaz. Yoğun aşkın aklı dağıtması ile şairin söz türleri arasında dolaşıp aşırıya kaçması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel ve kalıplaşmış genişlemelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Amaçsız dolaşma çekirdektir; aşk taşkınlığı ve şiirde söz alanları arasında gezinme bağımlı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın amaçsız dolaşmayı, yoğun aşka bağlı durumdan ve şiirle ilgili söz öbeklerinden ayrı fakat ilişkili yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Temel anlam, belirli bir amaç ve yön gözetmeden dolaşmak veya şaşkın halde oradan oraya gitmektir. Yoğun aşkın insanı aklı dağılmışçasına sürüklemesi ve şairin sözün türlü alanlarına dalıp aşırıya kaçması buna bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir amaç veya yön gözetmeden başıboş biçimde dolaşmak.
Şaşkınlık içinde yönünü ve amacını belirleyemeden oradan oraya gitmek.
Yoğun aşk yüzünden aklı karışmış veya saplantıya kapılmış gibi olmak ve sürüklenmek.
Şairin övgü, yergi ve başka söz türlerinin her birine dalıp bu alanlarda aşırıya kaçması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek amaçsız ve yönsüz gitmek ile şaşkın dolaşmaktır. Bu hareket görünümü yoğun aşkın aklı dağıtmasına, kalbin aşkla sürüklenmesine ve şiirde türlü söz alanlarına dalıp abartmaya genişler.

concept_gloss.text: amaçsızca başıboş dolaşma

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir amaç ve yön olmadan dolaşma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin şaşkın olduğu ve yönünü belirleyemediği hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yoğun aşkın kişiyi aklı dağılmış gibi sürüklediği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şairlerin çeşitli söz türlerine girip övgüde, yergide ve başka alanlarda aşırıya kaçmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Çeşitli söz alanlarında dolaşma ve aşırıya kaçma kullanımını korur.

error_profile.loses: Amaçsız dolaşma çekirdeğini, şaşkınlığı ve şiirle ilgili kalıplaşmış kullanımı kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek hareket bağlamında büyük ölçüde örtüşürler; bu dal aşk taşkınlığına ve şiirsel söz dolaşımına uzanmasıyla ayrılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Aşk yüzünden aklı dağılmış gibi amaçsız dolaşmayı ve genel yönsüz hareketi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiye veya şeye güçlü biçimde bağlanıp sürekli düşkün kalmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yoğun aşkın kişiyi egemenliği altına alması alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aşkı yönsüzlük ve akıl dağılması görünümüyle işler; komşu dal bağlılık ve sürekli düşkünlük üzerinde durur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan davranışındaki amaçsızlığı, şaşkınlığı ve aşkla sürüklenmeyi öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yerde sabit kalmadan dolaşma ve yön değiştirme hareketini içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal amaç ve bilinç kaybına bağlı insan dolaşmasıdır; komşu dal birçok canlıya ve farklı hareket amaçlarına yayılan daha geniş bir eylem alanıdır.

branches.branch_image_ar: ذهاب على الوجه بلا قصد من عشق أو تحير
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هام على وجهه، والهائم المتحير، وذهاب المرء بلا قصد، وشدة العشق حتى كالجنون أو الوسوسة، وخوض الشاعر في أودية الكلام.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه داء الإبل إلا إذا صار مثلا للعشق أو الذهاب بلا قصد، ولا العطش الحسي إلا حيث نص المصدر على امتداده إلى العشق.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العاشق الهيمان كأنه جن من العشق فذهب على وجهه على غير قصد (maqayis)؛ الهائم المتحير هام يهيم؛ الهيام كالجنون من العشق (ayn)؛ هام على وجهه يهيم هيما وهيمانا ذهب من العشق أو غيره؛ قلب مستهام (sihah)؛ إذا أحب المرأة؛ الهيام العشاق؛ الهيام الموسوسون؛ الهيوم أن يذهب على وجهه؛ الهائم المتحير؛ الهيام كالجنون من العشق (tahdhib)؛ استهيم فؤاده؛ الهيم هيمان العاشق؛ الشاعر إذا خلا في الصحراء هام؛ وادي الكلام (tahdhib)؛ هام على وجهه ذهب؛ في كل نوع من الكلام يغلون؛ المخالف للقصد الذاهب على وجهه؛ اشتد عشقه (mufradat)
